title: JANUS Engine R0A4D — Axle vane energy audit + crystal-trap/self-cleaning screen

user_design_hypothesis.axle_role: The already-rotating Axle should remain the primary mechanical anti-scale actor; when fragile fresh CaCO3 begins to form on the chamber wall, near-wall Axle edges/wipers disrupt it before a thick rigid shell develops.
user_design_hypothesis.vane_role: Integrated fins/vanes are secondary: primarily flow-conditioning and anti-scale geometry; any useful shaft-power recovery is accepted only if numbers show a net benefit.
user_design_hypothesis.crystal_trap_role: Crystal traps reduce the rate at which calcium reaches/attaches to the Axle chamber surfaces and collect removable CaCO3-rich solids in washable service chambers.
user_design_hypothesis.maintenance_goal: Shift calcium from adherent wall scale into removable solid product while keeping Axle torque, gill flux and pressure drop stable.

hydraulic_energy_model.hard_result: For a pump-driven closed loop, a vane cannot create a positive local energy gain from the same pressure drop it causes. With real pump and vane efficiencies below unity, P_recovered < P_pump_extra for all screened points. Therefore vane geometry is admitted primarily for scraping/mixing/flow distribution unless it harvests energy from an external water current or from hydraulic head that would otherwise be dissipated.

external_current_case.rule: If the water current is externally supplied by the environment, P_recovered = eta_vane * DeltaP_vane * Q may legitimately reduce Axle drive load, but the same extraction appears as additional hydrodynamic drag on the vehicle/structure and must be charged to the external-flow energy budget.

hydraulic_energy_model.design_decision: Do not shape the anti-scale vane to maximize turbine loading in the pump-driven Mode A loop. Minimize its incremental DeltaP while preserving wall-shear, circulation and crystal transport. Treat any recovered torque as a measured bonus.

crystal_trap_mass_partition_screen.purpose: Test the architecture without pretending that unmeasured JANUS precipitation kinetics are known.
crystal_trap_mass_partition_screen.normalized_basis: Let M_precipitable = 1.0 be whatever CaCO3 mass actually precipitates during a test interval. The model only partitions that measured mass; it does not predict how much precipitates.
crystal_trap_mass_partition_screen.interpretation: The combined architecture is multiplicative: even a moderate scraper becomes much more effective once crystal traps remove most precipitating solids before they can become adherent wall scale. These percentages are sensitivity parameters, not measured JANUS efficiencies.

factorial_experimental_test.goal: Separate the actual contribution of rotation/scraping from the actual contribution of crystal traps.
arms: A0: no trap + stationary Axle control
A1: crystal trap only + stationary Axle
A2: rotating Axle/wiper only + trap bypassed
repeat_under: candidate antiscalant arms only after POMS/material compatibility passes
measurements: total CaCO3 mass formed or precipitable balance during the interval
particle size distribution in trap and circulating water
pH, conductivity, calcium hardness and alkalinity
factorial_experimental_test.success_definition: A3 must reduce wall deposition relative to A0/A1/A2 while keeping added hydraulic + mechanical power inside the Mode A auxiliary budget and without measurable POMS oxygen-flux degradation.

near_wall_axle_design.concept: Axle ring runs very near the chamber wall so existing rotation repeatedly encounters fresh fragile scale and prevents thick-shell maturation.
near_wall_axle_design.preferred_implementation: small controlled clearance plus replaceable compliant/sacrificial wiper edge; hard continuous metal-on-wall contact remains a test-only hypothesis rather than the baseline.
why: fresh CaCO3 can be brittle/easier to detach than mature scale
crystal traps reduce the frequency and thickness of deposits the Axle must encounter
compliant edge tolerates thermal/runout variation better than rigid rubbing contact
replaceable edge limits wear debris and protects chamber surface

existing_operational_invariants_carried_.condensate_policy: clean condensate may be returned only after contamination class is known; compressor condensate is not automatically admitted to the Axle water loop
existing_operational_invariants_carried_.nitrogen_policy: N2 purge/condensate-return duty must be mass- and pressure-balanced and should not unnecessarily strip CO2 from the water if that would increase CaCO3 precipitation tendency

CaCO3_product_boundary.note: Do not call the product construction-grade limestone until composition, moisture, contaminants, particle morphology and mechanical/use-specific specifications are measured.
possible_later_uses: process calibration by weighing recovered solids

test_verdict.main_next_unknown: Measured eta_trap, wall-removal rate, incremental DeltaP, Axle torque and J_O2 drift under real water chemistry.

next_gate: R0A4E_CALCIFER_FACTORIAL_LONG_HOLD: run A0/A1/A2/A3 for long enough to observe measurable scale, using weighed wall coupons and traps, while logging torque, DeltaP, pump/drive watts and POMS oxygen flux. Use measured trap/scraper efficiencies to replace the normalized sensitivity model.
